verbatim_quote.original: قبلش استتوس گیت رو بررسی کن، به من بگو.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Before that, check the git status and tell me.

extracted_decision.summary: Nothing destructive (prune/push/restart) happens before the Manager sees the worktree status first.
extracted_decision.rationale: Status-first is the safety gate before irreversible steps.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: One extra report turn per destructive sequence.
